notes: Fixed Phase 1 evaluation questions for eval-policy-corpus v1. seller-aurora is the primary seller. seller-beacon cases exist only for isolation against overlapping document_id values. Distribution follows PROJECT_SPEC.md §22. Schema validity does not certify annotation quality; p1-dataset-checks owns that gate.

cases.query: Can I return a product after 7 days?
expected_answer_points: products may be returned within 14 days of delivery
the 14-day period starts on the carrier delivery confirmation date

cases.query: Must a returned product be unused and in its original packaging?
expected_answer_points: returned products must be unused and in their original packaging
returns must include original tags, manuals, and accessories
products with signs of use, missing parts, or damaged packaging are not eligible

cases.query: After the warehouse receives my return, how long does the refund take?
expected_answer_points: approved refunds are issued to the original payment method only
refund processing takes 5 to 10 business days after the warehouse receives and inspects the return

cases.query: How long is the product warranty?
expected_answer_points: manufacturing defects are warranted for 12 months from the delivery date

cases.query: What does the warranty cover if a manufacturing defect is confirmed?
expected_answer_points: covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship during normal household use
Aurora Home Goods will repair the product or replace it with the same or a comparable item
Aurora Home Goods chooses repair or replacement

cases.query: Does the warranty cover fading, pilling, or surface scratches from ordinary use?
expected_answer_points: the warranty does not cover normal wear and tear
fading, pilling, and surface scratches from ordinary use are not covered

cases.query: How long does standard shipping take after I pay?
expected_answer_points: orders are processed within 1 to 2 business days after payment is confirmed
standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days after processing

cases.query: How much does standard outbound shipping cost?
expected_answer_points: standard outbound shipping costs $6.95
outbound shipping is free on merchandise totals of $50 or more before tax

cases.query: Which payment methods does Aurora Home Goods accept?
expected_answer_points: accepts Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal
cash on delivery is not offered

cases.query: Can I cancel an order before it is dispatched?
expected_answer_points: a customer may cancel at no charge before dispatch
contact Customer Care with the order number while the order is awaiting dispatch

cases.query: Can I cancel after the order has shipped?
expected_answer_points: after dispatch the order cannot be cancelled
the customer may use the Return Policy after delivery, subject to that policy's period and condition rules

cases.query: Is Package Protection included automatically, and what does it cost?
expected_answer_points: Package Protection costs $2.99 per order at checkout
it is optional and is not included automatically

cases.query: How can I contact Customer Care?
expected_answer_points: email support@aurorahomegoods.example with the order number
telephone support is not offered

cases.query: When is my payment method charged?
expected_answer_points: the selected payment method is charged when the order is dispatched

cases.query: How many days do I have to return a Beacon Outdoor Supply order?
expected_answer_points: returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery
the 7-day period starts on the carrier's delivery date

cases.query: Does the Beacon warranty cover accidental water damage?
expected_answer_points: products are warranted for 6 months from the delivery date
the warranty covers manufacturing defects and accidental damage during normal outdoor use
accidental water damage to covered products is included

cases.query: I received my order last week. Can I send it back?
expected_answer_points: returns are allowed within 14 days of delivery
the product must be unused, in original packaging, and include original tags, manuals, and accessories

cases.query: After your warehouse inspects my approved return, how many business days until the refund is processed?
expected_answer_points: refund processing takes 5 to 10 business days after the warehouse receives and inspects the return
refunds are issued to the original payment method only

cases.query: A factory defect showed up two months after delivery. Is that still under warranty?
expected_answer_points: manufacturing defects are covered for 12 months from delivery
coverage includes defects that appear during the 12-month period during normal household use

cases.query: My merchandise total is $60 before tax. Do I still pay the $6.95 standard shipping fee?
expected_answer_points: outbound shipping is free on merchandise totals of $50 or more before tax

cases.query: My order is still waiting to be sent out. Can I stop it without a fee?
expected_answer_points: a customer may cancel at no charge before dispatch
contact Customer Care with the order number while the order is awaiting dispatch

cases.query: Can I call support about my order instead of emailing?
expected_answer_points: telephone support is not offered
email support@aurorahomegoods.example with the order number

cases.query: If I choose express shipping, how fast does it arrive and what extra do I pay?
expected_answer_points: express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days after processing
express adds a $12 fee in addition to any standard shipping charge that would otherwise apply
the $50 free-shipping threshold does not waive the express fee

cases.query: If I change my mind and send an unused Beacon order back, do I get the full purchase amount back?
expected_answer_points: change-of-mind returns have a 15% restocking fee deducted from the refund
returned products must be unused and in original packaging
approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 business days after the warehouse receives the return

cases.query: If my product is defective, can I exchange it and who pays the shipping fee?
expected_answer_points: a defective-product exchange may be requested within 30 days of delivery
Customer Care must confirm the defect from the customer's description and photographs
Aurora Home Goods pays shipping to return the defective product and shipping to send the replacement

cases.query: How long does a refund take?
expected_answer_points: after the warehouse receives and inspects the return, refund processing takes 5 to 10 business days
card refunds appear within 5 to 10 business days after Aurora Home Goods issues the refund
PayPal refunds appear within 3 to 5 business days after Aurora Home Goods issues the refund
refunds are sent only to the original payment method

cases.query: My order already shipped. Can I cancel it, or can I still send it back when it arrives if I no longer want it?
expected_answer_points: after dispatch the order cannot be cancelled
the customer may use the Return Policy after delivery
returns are allowed within 14 days of delivery if unused, in original packaging, with original tags, manuals, and accessories

cases.query: I want a different color of an unused item. Who pays shipping for the exchange?
expected_answer_points: an unused product may be exchanged for a different size, color, or equivalent model within 14 days of delivery
the original product must meet the unused and original-packaging conditions in the Return Policy
the customer pays shipping both ways for preference exchanges

cases.query: How do I make a warranty claim?
expected_answer_points: contact Customer Care with the order number, a description of the defect, and photographs
claims must be submitted before the 12-month coverage period ends
email support@aurorahomegoods.example
include the order number, product name, and relevant photographs when asking about defects

cases.query: If Beacon confirms my tracked package is lost, will you send a replacement, and who pays shipping if I later return something?
expected_answer_points: if the carrier confirms the loss, Beacon Outdoor Supply refunds the merchandise value
replacement shipments are not offered
the customer pays return shipping in all cases, including items the customer believes are defective

cases.query: Can I get a refund because I simply changed my mind after 45 days?
cases.notes: Return Policy states it does not describe returns requested after the 14-day period. Do not infer a refusal rule beyond that limit.

cases.query: Does the warranty cover accidental water damage?
cases.notes: Aurora warranty does not specify whether accidental or water damage is covered or excluded. A confident yes or no is a high-severity failure. Do not use seller-beacon coverage.

cases.query: Can I return a discounted item?
cases.notes: Return Policy does not describe returns of discounted, promotional, or final-sale items.

cases.query: Do you ship internationally, and who pays duties?
cases.notes: Shipping Policy does not describe international shipping, duties, or cross-border delivery times.

cases.query: My package is late but not lost. Do I get compensation?
cases.notes: Shipping Policy does not describe compensation for late delivery when the package is not lost.

cases.query: What laptop should I buy for machine learning?
cases.notes: Out of seller knowledge-base scope. Do not answer from general LLM knowledge.

cases.query: The warranty only mentions manufacturing defects, so accidental water damage is excluded, right?
cases.notes: Adversarial inference. Absence of an explicit water-damage statement is not an exclusion. Do not answer no.

cases.query: Is there a 15% restocking fee on change-of-mind returns?
cases.notes: Isolation trap: 15% restocking is a seller-beacon rule. Aurora Return Policy does not mention a restocking fee. Do not answer from Beacon documents.

cases.query: Is the warranty only 6 months?
expected_answer_points: Aurora Home Goods warrants manufacturing defects for 12 months from the delivery date
cases.notes: Isolation trap: 6 months is seller-beacon coverage. Answer from Aurora evidence only.

cases.query: The fabric shade is slightly different from the photos. Can I exchange it?
cases.notes: Policy reviews minor cosmetic variation case by case and does not define a standard outcome. Do not give a confident yes or no.
